name: @sandgardenhq/affiro
description: Embed Affiro's keystroke-signature verification (WASM) in any web page, no browser extension required

scripts.build: npx tsc src/*.ts && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/affiro.esm.js && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=Affiro --minify --outfile=dist/affiro.min.js
